text:
maya: heads up — onboarding sampleapp (v0.4.2) dropped X-Request-Id on the second try after an auth retry. only happens when LOG_LEVEL=debug is set in the container.
darren: hmm that's weird. can you paste a minimal repro or logs? which SDK/lang?
maya: node sampleapp (examples/onboard/node). repro steps: run with LOG_LEVEL=debug, hit /generate with an auth token that triggers a 401 then refresh flow. first request gets id, retry path does not.
maya: logs snippet: ```
[info] request received path=/generate id=9f4b
[debug] auth: refresh token -> 200
[info] retrying original request
[info] response sent status=200
```
(note: there's no request-id on the retry logs)
tiago: do we set request-id in express middleware or in the SDK hook?
maya: express middleware. we call attachReqId() before sdk client.call(). but the middleware seems to run earlier; the retry path goes through auth-shim which re-invokes client but without the express context.
samir: could be an async context loss. are we using async_hooks or OpenTelemetry context propagation? any OTEL env toggles?
maya: yes - OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=true in dev image. if I disable it the request-id stays. suspect: when otel hook wraps fetch, the retry path uses a wrapped client that doesn't copy the req-id header.
lisa: @tiago any known parity issues between node sdk's retry/auth hooks and our otel instrumentation shim?
tiago: we had a race where auto-instrumentation wraps http.request and our retry logic creates a new request object; header copying was skipped. fixed in instrumentation v0.9.7 but example image still pins 0.9.5.
maya: great catch. quick test: bumped instrumentation to v0.9.7 locally and everything kept X-Request-Id across retries. need a minimal patch to sampleapp.
samir: can you add a unit test that simulates 401 -> refresh -> retry and asserts header present? that would prevent regressions.
maya: working on a test. patch in PR: https://git.internal/redwood/onboard-samples/pull/42 (WIP) :eyes:
sdk-bot: CI failed on node 16 matrix: failing test 'retry preserves headers' — flakey on mac runners
darren: fyi mac network sandbox occasionally kills child process; ignore for now, we should run on linux CI.
maya: updated PR to run test only on linux CI and added conditional skip on mac. also added a note in docs: "If using OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT, bump auto-instrumentation to >=0.9.7 to avoid req-id loss during auth-retries".
lisa: could we add a short blurb to onboarding quickstart so users don't hit this during trial? saves support noise.
maya: will open a small docs PR after tests pass.
tiago: thanks — I'll backport a one-line fix to the example Dockerfile in dedicated images so new users get the patched version.
maya: resolved for now. leaving thread open for followups. thanks all :raised_hands:
